consumed.resolution: Fixed by the two-phase landing with a write-ahead intent (ADR-0039 §8.1) on branch fix/ship-landing-resumes-across-a-failed-push. Each acceptance test is green, and 14 overlay mutants are dead. Two binding sites (native.go post-push idempotency, audit.go post-push predicate evidence) stay open under carried-ship-resume-binding-sites-skip-the-rule.

fix: A two-phase landing with a write-ahead landing intent, in one home: go/internal/phases/ship/landing (ADR-0103 unit 07, which already owns the ff-merge, the push and the ship-binding witness); design home ADR-0039 §8. (1) Prepare: after verifyStagedTree and the lane commit, before any shared-ref mutation, atomically write <run workspace>/landing-intent.json {cycle, run_id, audit_artifact_sha256, audited_tree, worktree_base_sha, commit_sha, commit_tree, consumed_paths, explanation_view_sha256, pre_main, branch} and journal commit_sha. (2) Commit: require main to be an ancestor of commit_sha; push commit_sha:refs/heads/<branch> FIRST; only then ff the plane main under ship.lock; verifyCommittedTree with the consumption excuse read from the intent; writeShipBinding; complete the intent. (3) landing.Resume is the first stage of ship.Run (runNative skips the repo-contract pack when it applies): an incomplete intent for this cycle+run whose commit and tree resolve, whose audit row is still the newest for the run, whose lane tip is commit_sha, and whose origin is an ancestor of commit_sha resumes at step 2 and re-runs no gate. repairResumeUnpushed is retired into it. (4) On a non-resumable exit back to Audit or Build, unwind the lane to the audited shape (B1 unwindShipCommit/pendRebasedChange) so Audit and the explanation never measure ship's own commit. (5) Secondary: classify push stderr (transport/5xx → bounded jittered retry of the identical push; race → fetch+ff probe; policy → precondition, no retry) and fix the '…: <nil>' message. Rejected alternatives: (b) binding the explanation base to the recorded pre-commit base is already true (base check explanationdocs.go:272 passed). Ordering-only (c) leaves the consumption in the lane commit, so the digest still mismatches. Excluding .evolve/inbox from the digest turns the retry into a vacuous no-push PASS (worktree_ship.go:143-146).
source: console forensics, 2026-10-07, wave 77 cycle 1830 (lane cli-phase-cycle-request): GitHub returned 500 on both pushes at 15:08:31Z and 15:08:34Z
summary: Cycle 1830 passed audit (15:05:22Z, tree ad697a29 on base 63eb3af76). Ship committed the audited tree plus its inbox consumption as ba61c7341, fast-forwarded the shared local main to it (worktree_ship.go:181 Integrate before :185 pushWithRepair), then the push and the repair's one identical retry both got GitHub 500. Nothing completed or undid the local effects: ship-binding.json and the ship-journal entry are written only after a successful push, and the consumed paths that excuse the consumption drift live only in memory. recover:transient-retry-ship re-ran Ship.Run from the top. The explanation gate (ship.go:227 → explanationdocs.go:292-297) hashed the lane worktree against the UNCHANGED recorded base 63eb3af76 and now included ship's own consumption pair: sealed 7bfb80dc…, measured 8eb4ced1…. A replica of foldPathStates reproduces both; dropping the two inbox paths gives exactly 7bfb80dc. That routed to precondition-reaudit, and the re-audit FAILed deterministically on the same gate (15:17:28Z). Had the gate passed, verifyAuditBinding would still have raised AUDIT_BINDING_HEAD_MOVED (ship's own ff moved the plane HEAD), and repairResumeUnpushed declines every consuming cycle (repair.go:318-329, HEAD^{tree} != bound). Meanwhile ba61c7341 sits unpushed and unjournaled on local main; laneStartRef forks new lanes from it (worktree.go:122-124); peer 1829 fleet-rebased onto it and its push will publish it regardless of 1830's verdict. The existing resume test passes only because its fixture consumes nothing and activates no explanation contract.
title: A failed push leaves ship's commit and main fast-forward neither completed nor undone, so a transient 5xx becomes a deterministic re-audit FAIL and strands audited work on the shared main
